harper: Postmortem follow-up: auth provider latency caused cascading token refreshes and overloaded model-registry. Need owners + short timelines.

nate: I can own gateway tweaks. Plan: drop auth retries to 1 on 5xx, add exponential backoff + jitter, and feature-flag a circuit-breaker. Small PR by Mon.

elen: I'll own model-registry fallback and metrics. Add cached-token fallback on auth 5xx, emit token_refresh_rate and token_errors, and wire alerts. Staging by Thu.

sre-bot: Ticket INC-5401 created and linked. DR run scheduled 2027-04-17 09:00 UTC.

provider-support: Opened case with provider, requested auth endpoint traces and latency histograms; case #PV-7788.

harper: Actions: A1 nate (gateway) PR Mon, canary Wed; A2 elen (registry) staging Thu, prod next Tue; A3 provider-support (logs) report by EOD. We'll run DR after prod changes. Post short updates here only (e.g., "nate: PR merged").
